newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said it has qualified for municipal bond insurance the following eight municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Tucson, Ariz., $11.7 million water supply system revenue bonds and $5 million revenue bonds and $10.51 million eneral obligations (GOs).
--Hillman Community Schools, Mich., $8.345 million school building and site bonds.
--Barton County USD, Kan., $9.75 million school GOs
--North Plainfield, N.J., $4.025 million general improvement bonds.
--Salamanca City SD, N.Y., $4.49 million school disatrict GOs.
--Grantsburg SD, Wis., $1.78 million school building GOs.
